titre: Fiche SIRENE et profil LinkedIn : la même société ?
description: Pour joindre une base d'entreprises publique (SIRENE) à des comptes LinkedIn sans clé commune, Jev compare les deux fiches et dit si elles parlent de la même société. Sert au dédoublonnage et au rattachement d'un contact à son entreprise.

meme_societe.instructions: Do `sirene` (a record from the French company registry) and `linkedin` (a LinkedIn company page) describe the same company? Names may differ in form (legal name vs brand, accents, abbreviations, 'SAS' or 'SARL' suffixes). Location, activity and size must be compatible.

criteria.true: Same company: names match or one is the brand of the other, and city, activity and size are consistent or unknown.
criteria.false: Different companies: names refer to different entities, or the city, activity or size clearly contradict each other (a bakery vs a software company, Lyon vs Lille, 5 employees vs 5,000).
